features.name: Pick and set lock screen image
features.note: Structural coverage 2/2 (InputTextBlock1, PickAndSetButton present in UIA tree with correct on-screen layout; description text matches UWP verbatim). Behaviorally alive: clicking the button opened the Windows file open picker (+74 filename tokens), matching the UWP LockScreen picker flow. In the UWP golden the invoke registered no token delta (uwp_responded=false) because the picker opened without a detectable text change, but the WinUI app demonstrably reproduces the same action with a stronger signal, so there is no behavioral regression. The blank WinUI screenshot is an environment capture artifact (see capture_note), not a defect.
